statement: Independent community wired XUSB research and the consumer USB binding agree that 045e:028e's native XInput personality is a vendor-specific USB interface using XUSB frames rather than a standard HID Game Pad report descriptor.

applicability.revision: pinned community Free60 ab1fe19, protoR2 4c0d062, x360w a8ac630; Linux 4056b3c; SDL 535d80b and 829a65d; retail revision unknown
applicability.scope: protoR2 179-202; xpad.c 477-501. Community secondary reference plus consumer source agreement; physical descriptor not captured. Not an architectural obligation for virtualgamepad's deliberately generic-HID UHID mode.
